{{- $type := .Get "type" | default "note" -}} {{- $title := .Get "title" -}} {{- $fold := .Get "fold" -}} {{- $icon := "info" -}} {{- if eq $type "warning" -}}{{- $icon = "warning" -}} {{- else if or (eq $type "error") (eq $type "danger") (eq $type "failure") -}}{{- $icon = "error" -}} {{- else if eq $type "tip" -}}{{- $icon = "lightbulb" -}} {{- else if eq $type "success" -}}{{- $icon = "check_circle" -}} {{- else if eq $type "note" -}}{{- $icon = "sticky_note_2" -}} {{- end -}}
{{- if $fold -}}
{{ $icon }} {{ $title | default (humanize $type) }}
{{ .Inner | safeHTML }}
{{- else -}}
{{ $icon }} {{ $title | default (humanize $type) }}
{{ .Inner | safeHTML }}
{{- end -}}
